atoms.title: The Double Bass
atoms.b: The double bass is a large string instrument and usually has four strings.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>instrument-double-bass-1</voice> <break time='1000ms'/> The double bass is a large string instrument and usually has four strings.

instruction.text: What does the double bass look like?
Find and select the double bass.
instruction.sound: Find and select the double bass.

atoms.b: Since the double bass is so large, it is usually played standing up. You prop up the double bass on the floor using a point located on its underside. Like a violin, you can either pluck a double bass or draw a bow across its strings.

atoms.b: The double bass has ((2 ++4 6 8)) strings and therefore belongs in the ((spring_instrument ++string_instrument sing_instrument)) family.
atoms.sound: The double bass has four strings and therefore belongs in the string instrument family.

atoms.b: You can play the strings by ((singing painting ++stroking)) them with a ((mallet ++bow arrow)) or by using your fingers to ((++pluck grip rub)) the strings.
You usually play the double bass while ((lying_down ++standing sitting running)).
